title: Product Data Scientist (Contract)
description:
Product Data Scientist

Hybrid - 2 days in office

London-based

£400 per day

Outside IR35

Initial 3-Month Contract


This is an opportunity to join a growing data function at a pivotal stage of its evolution. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and business teams, using advanced analytics and experimentation to shape product strategy, improve user experiences, and drive data-informed decision making across the organisation.


The Company

They are a digitally focused organisation with a strong commitment to using data to inform strategic and operational decisions. Their data team is expanding as they continue to enhance how analytics supports product development and business growth. You'll join a collaborative environment where innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement are highly valued.


The Role and Deliverables

  • Leverage quantitative analysis and data storytelling to understand user behaviour, identify opportunities, and support product strategy.
  • Design, support, and evaluate experiments to generate insights and uncover new opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with stakeholders, engineers, and developers to define key metrics and ensure consistent, accurate reporting.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytics tools that enable teams to access actionable insights.
  • Deliver deep-dive analyses and recommendations that influence product and business decisions.
  • Support a strong data culture by documenting insights, promoting best practices, and helping teams align on data definitions and sources.


Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience using data to solve business and product challenges within a digital or technology-led environment.
  • Proficiency with SQL and analytical tools such as Python, R, dbt, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with BI and visualisation platforms such as Looker, Tableau, Lightdash, or equivalent tools.
  • Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and communicate findings effectively to a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Strong data storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decisions through evidence-based insights.
  • Collaborative approach combined with a proactive, detail-oriented mindset and curiosity for understanding user behaviour.


How to Apply

Register your interest by sending your CV to Ananya Gupta via the Apply Link on this page.
